description: I write this as a mother.I write this as a daughter.And now, I write this as a candidate for North Carolina House District 99.For most of my life, I have lived with a quiet, constant fear that many Black parents know too well; the fear of raising a Black son in America. • Worried about traffic stops for taillights that weren’t out. • Worried about no-knock warrants at the wrong house. • Worried about him walking home, driving to his grandmother’s house in Kannapolis, canvassing for candidates,
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Campaign to Elect Veleria M
title: When Everyone Becomes a Target: ICE, DHS & Why This Moment Should Alarm Us All
